title: Microservices
description: Monitoring of the microservices profile (docker compose --profile microservices)

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (application, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, application, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
